name: יְהַלֶּלְאֵל
gloss: he praises God; or may he praise God
summary: A man of Judah whose sons were Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel (1Ch 4:16), and a Merarite Levite, father of Azariah, who rose to cleanse the house of Yahweh under Hezekiah (2Ch 29:12). The name has the form of the piel imperfect of הָלַל with אֵל, “he praises God” or “may he praise God”, the form of “let them praise (יְהַלְלוּ) the name of Yahweh” (Psa 148:5); scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “The sons of יְהַלֶּלְאֵל: Ziph and Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.”
Of the sons of Merari, “Azariah son of יְהַלֶּלְאֵל”.
They gathered their brothers and went in to cleanse the house of Yahweh.
“יְהַלְלוּ the name of Yahweh”: the piel imperfect that is the name's first part.

note: Takes e.bp.ag (2 tokens) and j.av.aq (a zero-token cross-reference). The two bearers are separate TIPNR records.
